title: +*GENERAL CHEMISTRY I LABORATORY FOR CHEMISTRY MAJORS
description: Focuses on experiments that correspond to the topics covered in CH 221Z including the fundamentals of chemical measurements, quantitative relationships in chemical analysis, and understanding atomic and molecular structure. (Core Education or Bacc Core Course if taken with CH 221Z)
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Chemistry (520).
